How this concept plays

Declare and assign variables to unlock coffins, gates, and a route out of the castle. The shared DOM runtime presents each prompt as an interactive task instead of a four-button quiz: word and step ordering, token assembly, fill-in repair, classification, and typed recall. Every classic variation rotates six of those mechanics and keeps the Defense art identity.

Shared-mechanic note: 499 of the 500 classic variations run on the same adaptive DOM runtime. Platformer Quest Variation 01 is the only bespoke build: it keeps its own Phaser scenes and an 8-question gate bank. The shared variations are complete data-driven configurations, not 500 separate engines. The art theme adds visual identity; it does not turn each variation into a bespoke game.

Questions come from the local concept bank (6 prompts, shuffled per seed). Art and audio are local CC0 Kenney assets: the original starter pack plus seven curated theme packs. No remote scripts, fonts, or services.
